title: Bayang-Bayang di Rak
theme: Menjelajahi kecemasan tak terucap yang muncul di tengah kesunyian malam, mencari makna dalam keheningan rutinitas yang tampak sederhana.

cover.prompt: A tranquil early morning urban street scene, rendered with a cinematic aesthetic. Subtle, warm artificial light emanates from a distant convenience store sign, casting a soft glow on the quiet pathway. A generic, featureless silhouette of a person, wearing a jacket, is walking away from a residential building. The cool, crisp morning air is palpable. The composition emphasizes the peaceful emptiness of the street and the gentle architecture, conveying a sense of quiet introspection and the anticipation of a simple comfort. Focus on atmospheric depth and environmental detail.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: A freelance designer, exhausted from work, ventures into a deserted 24-hour convenience store for a snack. Amidst perfectly organized shelves, she encounters a peculiar, old-fashioned jar of nutmeg preserves. This minor anomaly triggers a cascade of overthinking and self-doubt, leading her to question reality versus her own mental state. Upon closer inspection, she finds a single, faded word – "Jaga" (Care/Guard) – inside the jar, which, though not logically explained, brings her a sense of acceptance regarding her introspective tendencies and the beauty of life's imperfections and unresolved mysteries.
